description: What the desktop app and the interview site promise each other. Source of truth is the app repo; the site keeps a copy in src/contract/. See docs/web-contract.md.

violationCodes.meaning: A blocklisted meeting, screen-share, casting/remote or browser app is running. One violation per category, apps in `apps`.
An AI assistant is running: on the blocklist (category "ai") or found by the agent ("agent").
Agent: a transparent overlay window is over the screen.
Agent: a blocked app is running under another name.
A second display is connected. Re-sent every 15s while it stays connected.
One display, but more physical monitors behind it (Duplicate mode). Re-sent every 15s while it stays.
Agent: the computer is being used through remote desktop.
Agent: the computer is a virtual machine.
Any other agent finding, or an event without its own code (deep-link swap).
The security agent didn't answer, or couldn't finish its checks, 3 times in a row.
The display (category "hdmi") or process (null) check couldn't answer 3 times in a row.
The candidate tried to minimize the window (undone).
The candidate opened the exit dialog and cancelled it.
Another app came to the front (Windows: its name is in `apps`). The app brings the interview back.
Windows: the interview window is no longer on the current virtual desktop.

treatAsValues.hard: Ends the interview the first time.
treatAsValues.soft-then-hard: A strike the first time; the app marks a repeat isHardBlock.
treatAsValues.strike: A strike on the site's own limit. isHardBlock is always false.
treatAsValues.site-decides: Never a hard block. The site's own focus tracking already covers it.
treatAsValues.follow-isHardBlock: Hard when isHardBlock is true, otherwise a strike.

violationPayload.id: string (UUID); acknowledge with it; kept on redelivery
violationPayload.category: hdmi | meeting | screen | wireless | browser | ai | agent | null
violationPayload.apps: string[] of display names, may be empty
violationPayload.count: number of times this event text fired this session
violationPayload.isHardBlock: boolean: severity high or count >= 2; always false when neverHardBlock

set.meaning: Access token, when a session is available
Refresh token, when a session is available
Base64 data URL of the live photo from identity verification
Chosen UI language. Prefer the lang query param, which is set before any script runs.

reasons.format: ^[\w:-]{1,40}$; anything else is stripped by the app, and an empty result becomes "unknown"

interviewComplete.meaning: Ended for a violation, face mismatch or security block
Start request refused by the backend

abortInterview.meaning: No attempts left; the dashboard shows the exhausted note
Start request refused by the backend
Start request never reached the backend
Back to dashboard from the 404 page
Back to dashboard from the error page

reasons.abortInterviewNote: Refused once startProctoring() has been called. Any reason other than attempts-exhausted shows "couldn't start" on the dashboard.
